scope: Final encoded audio in the Chinese 1920x1080 delivery only. Other language/resolution files are not covered by this record.
measurement_method: Initial delivered AAC track was measured with FFmpeg loudnorm; input_i/input_tp/input_lra report actual encoded audio. Following a visual-only rerender, these figures are retained with the exact numerical fingerprint matches documented in file_refresh; no repeat loudnorm was run in this refresh. No source, master or delivery was modified by this verifier.

boundaries.method: Decoded float PCM, content trimmed for analysis to the declared 34.000-second audio timeline; assess endpoints, 5 ms sample differences and fade-window RMS. These are signal checks, not listening judgments.
boundaries.packet_timing_note: The first AAC packet carries 1024 priming samples marked Skip Samples. The final packet presents 16 ms to finish at 34.000 s. Raw PCM decoding exposes 256 extra codec-padding frames (5.333 ms) beyond the declared presentation timeline; this is frame padding, not an extension or truncation of the delivery timeline.

master_alignment.note: Near-unity gain and high zero-lag correlation support a continuous, unshifted encode of the supplied master; AAC coding changes individual samples.

subjective_listening_review: NOT_PERFORMED. This record does not claim listening approval or absence of perceptual AAC artifacts.
mutation: No audio source, master or delivered video was modified.
conclusion: PASS: AAC-LC, 48 kHz stereo, 34.000-second presentation timeline, -16.00 LUFS and -1.50 dBTP. No technical clipping, abrupt start/end boundary or missing tail is indicated. No audio change is required on the evidence measured.

file_refresh.reason: The director rerendered one compositing frame to correct its transparency mask and added Rec.709 tags. Audio source and AAC encoding parameters were unchanged.
file_refresh.refresh_method: One decode of the new AAC track; compare stream parameters, sample counts, endpoint/fade-window numeric fingerprints, decoded sample peak, and zero-lag correlation/gain against the unchanged master and previous recorded values. No repeat loudness analysis was performed.
file_refresh.aac_hash_method: FFmpeg -map 0:a:0 -c copy -f hash -hash sha256; hash of stream-copied encoded packet data, excluding container and video.
file_refresh.direct_prior_payload_identity: Not established byte-for-byte: the superseded MP4/AAC payload hash was not retained. All previously recorded audio stream and signal fingerprints match exactly at recorded precision. New encoded/decoded hashes are saved for future comparisons.
file_refresh.loudness_reuse: The prior measured -16.00 LUFS, -1.50 dBTP and 5.10 LU LRA are retained on matching-source, parameters and numerical-fingerprint evidence; final all-delivery analysis by the director remains the independent final-file confirmation.

final_cfr_export_refresh.reason: CFR source-boundary rounding correction changes visual frames only; audio mastering and encoding settings unchanged.
